blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Former Bureau of Fire Protection (BFP) chief Jesus Fernandez pleaded not guilty on Friday to a graft charge before the Sandiganbayan Third Division over an alleged P4 million bribe. Third Division Clerk of Court Dennis Pulma read the charge against Fernandez before Associate Justice Ronald Moreno, who presided over the arraignment. “I plead not guilty, your honors,” Fernandez said. The prosecution will present nine witnesses, while the defense will have four. Trial is set to begin on Oct. 21.
